description: Discount / markdown calculator. Give an original price plus exactly one of discountPercent, discountAmount, or finalPrice and the other two are derived. Pass discountPercents instead to stack discounts in sequence, where 20% then a further 10% is an effective 28% off rather than 30%. Pure arithmetic, no live price feed and no tax or shipping.

discountAmount.description: Discount as an absolute amount off the original price

discountPercent.description: Discount as a percent of the original price (0-100). Provide exactly one of discountPercent, discountAmount, finalPrice.

discountPercents.description: Successive discount percents applied in order, each off the running price (max 20). Overrides the single-discount fields when present.

finalPrice.description: The price after the discount, to solve for the percent and amount

originalPrice.description: The price before any discount (must be greater than zero)

name: calculate_discount
